description: Inspect one file or exported symbol and return one typed evidence bundle. Address a file with target={type:"file", file:"src/a.ts"}; address a symbol with target={type:"symbol", file:"src/a.ts", export_name:"foo"}. Composes existing read-only analysis systems only: trace_file, trace_export for symbols, file-scoped dead-code actions, duplication groups filtered to the file, complexity findings filtered to the file, security candidates scoped to the file, and the impact closure for the file (the transitive affected-but-not-in-diff set plus the coordination gap: modules that consume this file's contract but are not shown alongside it; a syntactic attention pointer, not a correctness proof). Set include_churn=true to attach target-level git churn from the in-process health hotspot subsystem; it is off by default, and missing git history is reported explicitly. Set cloud=true on a file target to attach the `cloud` evidence section of `fallow inspect --cloud` (Fallow Cloud production data per local function); repo selects the `owner/repo`. The key comes from the server environment or `fallow cloud login`, never from the call. The section status is ok, no_key, plan_required, unavailable, or untracked, and a status other than ok does not fail the call; see fallow://tools/inspect_target. Set format="compact" to get the plain text of `fallow inspect --format compact` (about 1 KB, no JSON) instead of the bundle. production is forwarded only to child analyses that support it: trace, dead-code, and health. Symbol targets include file-scoped evidence with explicit scope fields because file:line enclosing-symbol mapping is a follow-up. This bundled query runs independent evidence analyses in parallel; large repositories can exceed the default 120s subprocess timeout, so raise FALLOW_TIMEOUT_SECS when needed.

oneOf.description: The plain text of `fallow inspect --format compact`.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

cloud.description:
Opt-in (default off): attach the Fallow Cloud `cloud` evidence section
for a file target: production data per local function. The CLI reads
the key: `FALLOW_API_KEY` in the server environment, else the key that
`fallow cloud login` stored. The section `status` is `ok`, `no_key`,
`plan_required`, `unavailable` or `untracked`. A status other than `ok`
does not fail the call. Refused for a symbol target.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

format.description:
Response format: `json` (default) returns the evidence bundle.
`compact` returns the plain text of `fallow inspect --format compact`:
about 1 KB, one line per item, and no JSON.

include_churn.description:
Opt-in (default off): attach target-level git churn evidence. Missing
git history is returned as an explicit unavailable evidence section.

max_output_bytes.description:
Byte cap for this call's response. Lowers the server cap (default
1000000); over it the call is REFUSED (`isError`, `exit_code: 2`).

production.description:
Production mode: exclude test, story, and dev files, only start/build
scripts, and report type-only dependencies. Forwarded only to child
analyses that support it: trace, dead-code, and health.

repo.description:
Fallow Cloud repository for `cloud`, as `owner/repo`. Needs
`cloud: true`. Precedence: this value, then `FALLOW_REPO` in the server
environment, then the `origin` git remote.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

symbol_chain.description:
Opt-in (default off): also attach the best-effort symbol-level call chain
(`fallow trace`) as the `symbol_chain` evidence section. Only
meaningful for a symbol target. Best-effort and syntactic, and kept
off the ranked path: resolved-vs-unresolved callees are
reported honestly, the chain is never folded into the ranked brief and is
never a focus-map / ranking input.

target.description:
The file or exported symbol to inspect. See the tool description for
the two addressing shapes.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

type_aware.description:
Include project-wide TypeScript semantic evidence for symbol targets.
`false` keeps the run syntactic, also when the config turns type-aware analysis on. `type_aware_projects` or `type_aware_require` turns it on and wins over `false`.

type_aware_projects.description: Explicit tsconfig paths for type-aware analysis.

type_aware_require.description: Whether incomplete semantic evidence is advisory or gating.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: inspect_target
